svg.title: Black over Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, standardized vivid colours. Museum-classified painting in painted aluminum. Projecting black form is simplified to its observed frontal silhouette; material depth and shadow omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sfmoma.org/artwork/99.338/; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
